high_level_description: The interior of the Metropolitan Cathedral of Mexico City, a vast stone nave with a golden baroque altarpiece and a pendulum hanging from the dome.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Mexico City; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright high-altitude sunlight with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Tall grey stone columns and vaults in soft light.

elements.desc: A towering golden baroque altarpiece full of carved columns, saints and gold leaf.
Tall grey stone columns and arches.
Tall grey stone columns and arches.
A long thin cable hanging from above ending in a metal pendulum weight just above a round drawing on the stone floor.
